text.content:

pages.name: P-02 · Ghoul Vitae on the Doorknob

text.content:
There's a smell of someone else's Vitae on the doorknob: it belongs to a ghoul. (Doc 10: ghoul Vitae on the doorknob and in the hallway.)

Where it's found

Main scene: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took} · Also in: @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE}

Auspex 4 (Spirit's Touch) on the doorknob: the mark of a ghoul waiting for their next dose. doc 10
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took} · Main (@UUID[JournalEntry.YD0Td8Y9aJyIpGSl]{Helen Ward's Apartment}): Smell of someone else's Vitae on the doorknob: it belongs to a ghoul (if it wasn't found earlier). doc 01, 10
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.CeLqLZCfHQEtHYlk]{Chapter 0 · What the Water Doesn't Wash Away} · Account: The one sniffing around the stairwell is a Gale ghoul (@UUID[Actor.BzNGxOAK3F6Uo56T]{MEN-04}). His Vitae is the @UUID[JournalEntry.j32Ohis1qKJB3jcx.JournalEntryPage.Sv7fUQ7md0daHTzy]{P-02} trail. doc 03

Note

If the coterie takes Helen away right away, @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01} happens at the hangar, and @UUID[JournalEntry.j32Ohis1qKJB3jcx.JournalEntryPage.Sv7fUQ7md0daHTzy]{P-02} is lost if it wasn't detected (doc 10).

pages.name: P-04 · Partial Copy of the File on a USB Drive

text.content:
On the body there's a USB drive with a partial copy of the File.

Where it's found

Main scene: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46} · Main: Wits + Awareness (Difficulty 3): the USB drive is in the inside pocket of the jacket, among the ashes. Taking it without the officers seeing: Dexterity + Larceny (Difficulty 3). doc 01, 10

Note

It's USB drive 1 (folders 2014–2018, includes the Larchmont). If the coterie doesn't get it, it enters the chain of custody and Hale copies it on Night 3 (Thermometer +1). Montgomery confiscates it in @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.xWx5IoPih8fX83b1]{A1-E03} if they show it to him, unless Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 3) (docs 10 and 11).

Thornquist confirms there are copies of the File on the market and that the courier is a thin-blood, Jun.

Where it's found

Main scene: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below} · Main (@UUID[JournalEntry.jg1zpvYlDFMJRY8Q]{The Sealed Underground (Seattle Underground)}): Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) with Thornquist: with one success he confirms there are copies for sale; with 3 or more, he reveals that Jun brought them to him and where she sleeps. Ezra gets +2 dice. doc 01, 10

text.content:
